card.name: Present-tense verb after a subject
card.fires_on: Present-tense linking or progressive verbs right after a subject such as "We", a person's name, or "You are", especially in WordPress comment prompts and news or web bios.

modes.label: Comment login prompt
modes.description: The words "commenting" and "using" in the WordPress "You are commenting using your account" line.
modes.example: You are commenting<< using>> your WordPress.com account.

modes.label: Subject then is/are
modes.description: The verb "is" or "are" right after a name or "we" at the start of a statement.
modes.example: We<< are>> so proud to welcome a new addition to

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese, Vietnamese and German words for "currently doing", so it appears to hold back progressive-aspect words in other languages.
card.plain: It fires on the verb that follows "we", a name or "you are", as in the blog comment prompt "You are commenting using..."
